note: Questions the keeper may ask a founder. A question is asked only when no connected source in answerable_by can fill its fields, and only the top 5 by importance are asked per round. Importance = weight x number of blocked rooms x money at stake where computable. An empty answerable_by means only the founder can answer.

questions.asks: What is your gross margin after product cost, shipping and payment fees?
questions.why: without margin every ROAS target is a guess

questions.asks: What CAC or MER do you consider healthy, and why?
questions.why: kill and scale rules need a target

questions.asks: Which product would you put in front of a first-time buyer, and which one do repeat buyers come back for?
questions.why: acquisition and retention creative start here

questions.asks: Which claims about your product are you certain you can back, and which must never appear?
questions.why: only the founder can approve a claim

questions.asks: Who actually buys, in your words, and who do you wish bought more?
questions.why: reviews and tickets answer most of this when connected

questions.asks: What discounts do you allow, how often, and what is off limits?
questions.why: promo history shows what happened, not what is allowed

questions.asks: When are your peak weeks, and which launches or events are planned in the next 90 days?
questions.why: plans are not in any API

questions.asks: Who ships your orders, from where, and how long does a shipment take?
questions.why: delivery promises in copy must match reality

questions.asks: Who makes your products, where, and what is the lead time to reorder?
questions.why: stock cover and reorder points need it

questions.asks: Who has to approve copy, spend changes and promos before they go live?
questions.why: routing decisions to the right person

questions.asks: Which channels matter most to you this quarter, and which are you done with?
questions.why: spend data shows the past, not the plan

questions.asks: What have you already tested that did not work, so we never propose it again?
questions.why: the registry starts empty for a new brand

questions.asks: Paste 3 pieces of copy you love and 3 you would never run.
questions.why: the site shows one voice; the founder knows the range

questions.asks: Which 3 to 5 brands do your customers compare you to?
questions.why: search results find lookalikes, not the real comparison set

questions.asks: Which apps and tools run your store, email, support and reviews?
questions.why: the crawl finds most of it; the rest is a 1-minute answer

questions.asks: What is your real returns and exchange policy, including exceptions you make?
questions.why: the site page and the practice often differ

questions.asks: Where else do you sell, and does anyone else sell your products online?
Roughly how many weeks of cash do you have at the current burn?
questions.why: changes how aggressive any plan should be

questions.asks: Which Amazon ASINs are yours, and do you have a reviews export from Seller Central or your review tool you can upload?
questions.why: the public sample of Amazon reviews is small; the export or the ASIN list makes the objection ladders reliable
